# ---------- move generation (new lines "#..." inserted before the "@" line) ----------
def gen_rule(cons, newch, castle_pat=r"\S+", ep_pat=r"\S+", new_ep="-"):
    keys = sorted(set(cons) | set(newch))
    pat = "@(?="
    rep = "#"
    pos = 0
    g = 0
    for k in keys:
        if k > pos:
            g += 1
            pat += "(?P<g%d>.{%d})" % (g, k - pos)
            rep += "\\g<g%d>" % g
        pat += cons.get(k, ".")
        rep += newch[k]
        pos = k + 1
    if pos < 64:
        g += 1
        pat += "(?P<g%d>.{%d})" % (g, 64 - pos)
        rep += "\\g<g%d>" % g
    g += 1
    pat += " (?P<cs>" + castle_pat + ") " + ep_pat + "\n)"
    rep += " \\g<cs> %s\n@" % new_ep
    add(pat, rep)
